dir.name: [COLOR red]👉 HOW TO ENABLE ADULT/XMAS MENUS:[/COLOR]
1. Go to SYSTEM -> SKIN SETTINGS -> Main Menus.
2. Choose Setup Aeon Nox Main Menu.
3. Scroll down until you see ADULT or XMAS (with an X).

build.name: [COLOR orange]***THE BIG ONE LIGHT BUILD***[/COLOR]
build.notes:
[COLOR red]How to Enable Adult Menu[/COLOR]

1. Go to the main home screen and click SYSTEM.
2. Select SKIN SETTINGS, then go to Main Menus.
3. Choose Setup Aeon Nox Main Menu.
4. Scroll down until you see ADULT (they will have an "X" next to them).
5. Click on Enable and enable the menu.
build.description: [COLOR cyan]Alpha Build v1.0[/COLOR] - Polished light theme interface layout featuring free non-debrid setup, pre-optimized video configurations, active cache adjustments, and pre-packaged open source plugins.
